intro: The Defias Traitor is a captured outlaw held at the base of the Sentinel Hill watchtower in Westfall. Caught red-handed by the People's Militia, he traded the secret location of the Brotherhood's headquarters to save his own neck.

p: Not every member of the Defias Brotherhood possesses fanatical loyalty to Edwin VanCleef's cause. When this petty thief was caught attempting to rob Farmer Saldean of his wagon, Gryan Stoutmantle's militia had him dead to rights. Facing the gallows, the thief chose self-preservation over brotherhood, offering up the exact whereabouts of their hidden base of operations in exchange for his life.
